name: Outgoing work sign-off log
summary: Every item that needs a responsible attorney's sign-off before it leaves the firm sits in one log, in the order it has to go out: waiting, approved or returned, with the attorney's own note. Anything close to its date with no decision is flagged first. The log tracks status and never touches the legal substance.

sources.title: The firm version of the work: status only, with no draft read or judged; items ordered by send-by date with a warning window in working days; decisions accepted only from the named attorney's own message or a named covering attorney; flags for work sent before approval, decisions passed on second-hand and items with no attorney or no date; an exported log with stated column headers and a stop on any mismatch; and a proposed update with history lines that a person checks and saves.

sources.contribution: Its version of the clinic review queue for England and Wales, which keeps a line for every action naming the supervising lawyer, the date and any comment, and treats the log as the clinic's evidence of supervision.

The original clinic review queue that the uk-agents version adapts: a student's work held until the supervising lawyer approves it or returns it with a comment, the most pressing items shown first, and approval kept with the supervising lawyer alone.
